violations.message: to fit the chip limit, reshaped parametric parts capsule_trap (same volume / channel length; aspect x0.5).

chamber 'capsule_trap' retains with pillars 25 um apart, below the 60 um smallest gap this process makes. This process has one fluidic layer, so a bought mesh floor has nothing to clamp it either. Needs a bought mesh held by a second layer (another process), finer features, or the retention step off-chip.
